purpose: Check that the candidate preserves the GVA -> GOS -> NOS ladder
pass_condition: All required identities are explicit and preserved with coherent units time support and ladder position
review_condition: Conceptually coherent but formula signs boundaries or ladder flow-through require human review
fail_condition: Ladder identity breaks or a decomposition object is added to its parent
examples_pass: NFC baseline GVA used as baseline

purpose: Check that the same flow claim surplus or decomposition is not counted twice
pass_condition: No mirrored transfer duplicate financial receipt duplicate or parent/decomposition duplicate is present
review_condition: Correction ingredient may be valid but payer receiver or imputed directions need review
fail_condition: Same flow is counted from both sides or financial receipts are treated as new productive value
examples_fail: Counting NFC paid interest and FC received interest as independent surplus sources

purpose: Check whether an object claims productive value creation
pass_condition: Productive-value claim is explicitly allowed by theory and boundary review
review_condition: Claim is restricted mixed or unresolved by boundary
fail_condition: Finance/banking or transfer flows are treated as productive value
examples_review: Corporate whole-sector adjusted NOS as mixed object

purpose: Classify finance-related flows without treating them as productive capital
pass_condition: Financial claim classification is explicit and use is limited to claim transfer appropriation monopoly channel or correction ingredient
review_condition: Financial channel is present but interpretation or direction needs review
fail_condition: Financial flow is treated as productive capital or added as new surplus source
examples_pass: Candidate with no finance uses not_applicable
examples_fail: Bank receipts counted as productive value

purpose: Flag unresolved commercial-capital and circulation boundaries
pass_condition: No commercial-capital blur is present or it is outside the object
review_condition: Commercial capital or business-wide boundary is present and explicitly flagged
fail_condition: Blur is silently solved by legal-form aggregation
examples_fail: Business-wide object treated as clean productive boundary

purpose: Check whether BEA/NIPA metadata can support the concept search
pass_condition: Current metadata candidate is exact and conceptually classified
review_condition: Line candidate is plausible or partial but requires sign boundary or conceptual review
fail_condition: Historical line number or Shaikh label is reused mechanically
examples_fail: Old Appendix line numbers reused as current variables

purpose: Check whether financial-service or imputed-interest lines are used as official-accounting output correction ingredients claims on surplus monopoly-power channels or transfer/appropriation channels rather than productive value creation
pass_condition: Financial lines are used only under an explicitly stated role and do not create a productive-value claim
review_condition: Financial lines are needed for a correction but may mix official FISIM/output accounting with labour-value categories
fail_condition: The candidate treats financial income interest receipts or FISIM as newly created productive value
examples_pass: Financial lines marked correction_ingredient_only with no productive-value claim
examples_review: Imputed-interest restoration candidate requiring FISIM/output interpretation review
examples_fail: FISIM or interest receipts treated as productive capital output in labour-value terms
